name: 500px
description: 500px is a photography community and portfolio platform for publishing images, discovering photographers, showcasing professional work, viewing statistics, and submitting eligible photos for licensing.
agentUseSummary: 500px is not available as a direct Relay connection because the provider officially shut down API access on June 15, 2018 and no replacement public developer contract is published. Relay will not revive retired endpoints, use historical keys, automate the signed-in website, scrape content, or infer private application calls.

providerSetup.blocker: 500px's current official support article states that free API access ended on January 24, 2018 and all API access, including existing keys, was shut down on June 15, 2018. The current support center publishes no replacement API, OAuth application program, hosted MCP, endpoint schemas, permission model, quota contract, credential lifecycle, or webhook contract.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep 500px unavailable. Re-evaluate only if 500px publishes a supported public API, hosted remote MCP, or documented partner integration contract with exact operations, permissions, quotas, credential lifecycle, webhooks, and distribution terms.

evidence.supports: 500px states that it stopped offering free API access on January 24, 2018 and shut down access for existing API keys on June 15, 2018 as part of a strategic shift.
The current 500px Support Center retains the API shutdown notice under Apps and Plugins but publishes no replacement developer API, SDK, OAuth application program, or hosted MCP.
Current account operations are documented as signed-in product procedures rather than a third-party developer contract.

500px's current terms excerpt prohibits robots, spiders, scrapers, and other automated site access without express written permission, so Relay will not substitute website automation for the retired API.
